label.name: Core Application Logic
label.summary: Initializes the application and configures the global Redux store and API middleware.

label.name: Global Action Constants
label.summary: Stores centralized string constants for Redux action types to ensure consistency across the app.

label.name: Shared UI Components
label.summary: Provides the primary layout and reusable interface components for the application's various views.

label.name: State Management Reducers
label.summary: Defines how the application state changes in response to actions for different functional modules.

label.name: Article Detail Components
label.summary: Contains the specific UI elements for viewing articles and interacting with their associated comments.

label.name: Homepage View Components
label.summary: Organizes the components used to build the main landing page and its content feeds.
